ChangesEvent.description: SSE names: open (ChangesOpen) on connect and on reconnect, change (Change) for one resource that changed, and resync (ChangesResync) for a subscriber that fell behind the bounded buffer. No event carries an id.

Change.description: One resource that changed: a Workspace or Session by id, with the name of the Workspace it belongs to, or the Organization's queue, which carries neither. Never a copy of its state.

Refetch.description: The event that means refetch every view the Client subscribes to. It carries no fields.

workspace.description: The name of the Workspace that holds the Session.
The Workspace whose Transcript a `transcript` subscription follows, addressed as the Transcript read addresses it. Required for `transcript`.

after.description: The last Transcript cursor the tab saw. Absent means from the beginning.

kinds.description: Comma-separated Transcript kinds, as the Transcript read takes them.

participant.description: The name a `transcript` subscription's follower joins presence under, refused as the Transcript read's `as` is. Absent means anonymous.

StreamEvent.description: The event's name and `data` are those of the per-resource stream the subscription follows: an `Event` for a Transcript, a `ChangesEvent` for notices.

cursor.description: The subscription's Transcript cursor after this event, on entry, Activity and cursor events only. It resumes the subscription as `after`.

data.description: The per-resource stream's payload for this event name.
